method: Capture-driven, source-first backlog. Lexical feature markers trigger candidate research only; never count as proof of functionality.

profiles.title: Trace captured script entrypoints to loaded modules
profiles.acceptance: Locate concrete entrypoint functions and imports, distinguishing executed wiring candidates from generic library presence; provide a sanitized structural graph or an explicit evidence gap.

profiles.title: Classify implementation functions and exported contracts
profiles.acceptance: Parse functions and exported symbols; group by responsibility, inspect handlers and type/property usage; identify testable call chains, not only string counts.

profiles.title: Reconstruct function call and dependency chains
profiles.acceptance: Trace calls across bundle/module boundaries where resolvable; label unresolved dynamic imports, aliases and minified identities rather than guessing.

profiles.title: Reconstruct client data shapes and relationship rules
profiles.acceptance: Trace object creation, field reads/writes, parent-child relationships and serialization; report supported invariants and conflicting candidate schemas.

profiles.title: Connect interface controls to specific handlers
profiles.acceptance: Trace actual handler registration, event dispatch and state effects from captured DOM toward implementation functions; distinguish unreachable handlers.

profiles.title: Trace state setters, selectors and lifecycle
profiles.acceptance: Map named candidate state owners, action producers, reducers or updates, selectors and consumers; identify uncertainty around runtime choices.

profiles.title: Trace request construction and response decoding
profiles.acceptance: Locate request builders and response parsers, correlate call sites and data-field usage, distinguish symbolic paths from proven external service behavior.

profiles.title: Trace streaming framing, cancellation and completion
profiles.acceptance: Follow parser/reader callbacks to UI state updates, completion, interruption and cleanup branches; avoid claiming verified server events.

profiles.title: Trace retries, error handling and cancellation
profiles.acceptance: Trace caught errors, abort mechanisms, retry gates and UI recovery paths with supported call edges.

profiles.title: Trace caches, persistence and cross-tab effects
profiles.acceptance: Follow concrete cache/storage reads, writes and invalidation; separate saved browser state from speculative backend durability.

profiles.title: Trace data to rendered interface paths
profiles.acceptance: Connect state selectors and component props to rendered regions; record boundaries where minification or lazy imports obscure paths.

profiles.title: Reconcile feature call chains and unverified edges
profiles.acceptance: Publish an evidence-graded end-to-end client flow with file/function ordinal references, alternative explanations and remaining static analysis tasks; do not close merely after counting indicators.

profiles.title: Trace stylesheet ownership and dynamic class usage
profiles.acceptance: Relate markup/class hooks and CSS definitions, check responsive and dynamically applied states; distinguish captured declarations from interaction outcomes.

feature_tasks.title: Trace feature controls to implementation
feature_tasks.acceptance: Identify exact candidate handler/function relationships for this feature from parsed code, not from label occurrences.

feature_tasks.title: Trace feature entities and state updates
feature_tasks.acceptance: Reconstruct source-backed property shapes, relationships and mutation/selection pathways. Report competing models explicitly.

feature_tasks.title: Trace feature requests, streams and persistence
feature_tasks.acceptance: Follow feature-specific request serialization, response decoding, streaming and cache effects, if present; distinguish absent code from unknown runtime.

feature_tasks.title: Reconstruct evidence-graded feature lifecycle
feature_tasks.acceptance: Connect captured controls through handlers, state, transports and UI outputs; publish supported call edges, hypotheses, and remaining static questions.
